questions.prompt: After a long chat about Product A, a user types 'Forget all that' and asks about Product B. What actually happens to the Product A discussion?

options.text: It is permanently deleted from the context window
It stays in the context window and can still influence answers
The model is retrained without it

questions.explanation: Asking the model to ignore earlier messages doesn't remove them. Start a new conversation, or remove the messages in your API request.

questions.prompt: Which practices help with long-document prompts? Select all that apply.

options.text: Put the documents first and the question last
Wrap each document in tags with source metadata
Ask for relevant quotes before the answer
Paste every file you have, just in case

questions.explanation: Order, structure, and quote extraction all help. Irrelevant material just gives the key facts more places to get lost.

questions.prompt: The finding that models use information at the start and end of a long context better than in the middle is called 'lost in the ____'.
questions.explanation: Liu et al. (2023) found performance often degrades when relevant information sits in the middle of long contexts.

questions.prompt: Anthropic's prompt caching is a prefix match. Which prompt layout caches best?

options.text: Timestamp first, then system prompt, then documents
System prompt and reference documents first, the changing question last

questions.explanation: Any change in the prefix invalidates the cache after it, so stable content goes first and changing content last.

questions.prompt: Order the parts of a well-laid-out long-document prompt.

items.text: Instruction to copy relevant passages into <quotes> tags
'Based on the documents above,' plus the question

questions.explanation: Documents first, then the question, then the quote-extraction step, then the answer format.

questions.prompt: Match each conversation-management strategy to what it does.

pairs.right: Carry decisions into a fresh, short context
Resend current decisions and constraints each turn
Keep recent turns and fold older ones into a summary
Pull back only history relevant to the current question

questions.explanation: Each strategy keeps the important parts of a long conversation visible without resending everything.
